# Debug logging disabled
DEBUG=false

# Configuration

MAX_LOG_SIZE=100MB

log() {
  if [ "$DEBUG" = "true" ]; then
    echo "[$(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')] [$LOG_LEVEL] $1"
  else
    echo "$1"
  fi
}

# Main execution
main() {
  log "Starting journalctl command..."
  journalctl -u myservice --no-pager -n 1000
  log "Command completed successfully"
}

main
